reason: Having quit another meal delivery service before, I'm much more drawn to Document A because it treats the four-week menu rotation realistically ('you'll see dishes come back around, and if a dish doesn't suit you, you can swap it out') rather than claiming 'you won't get bored' like B does. Document A also frames the trial week in a low-pressure, grounded way and makes the 15-minute call with the dietitian feel like a built-in step to tailor the plan to my tastes.
